name: Dark Pals: The 2nd Floor
summary: The next chapter of the mascot horror game Dark Pals: The 1st Floor is set in the abandoned depths of UpWard. Armed with your Ink Blaster, you solve puzzles and navigate encounters with new creatures, including the Devourer, while uncovering the mystery of your connection to UpWard and the Dark Pals.
